items.difficulty_reason: The lemma makes explicit, in terms of the identification of the localized categories of sheaves with the slices, the pullback and the lower shriek of the second localization attached to a morphism of the site (statement lines 5715-5738). The proof is a complete computation: the lower shriek is read off from the identity of the composites of the lower shrieks given by the companion result (proof lines 5741-5749); and the pullback is computed directly on the sheaf corresponding to an object of the slice, giving the fibre product description in the statement, with the author noting that the adjunction with the first description gives an alternative argument (proof lines 5755-5793). The non-formal content is the identification of the sheaf corresponding to an object of the slice and the resulting computation. The claim is H2: an explicit computation with each input named.
